records.label: Target Original Menu/Submenu
records.notes: Native slug/parent identity is the target substrate; transformations still require missing-target diagnostics.

records.label: Rename Menu Item
records.notes: Rename is established market parity across reviewed admin-menu editors.

records.label: Menu Order
records.notes: Native position/order substrate; deterministic conflict diagnostics remain WPE-owned.

records.label: Parent Reassignment
records.notes: Native parent identity is confirmed; moving pre-existing third-party items remains a bounded WPE transform.

records.label: Hide/Show Presentation Rule
records.notes: Presentation visibility never grants or revokes authorization for the target operation.

records.label: Role / Capability Visibility References
records.notes: Role/capability targeting is market parity, but effective role/capability truth belongs to Surface 30 / Policy.

records.label: Site / User Admin / Network Admin Context Visibility
records.notes: Site, user-admin and network-admin are distinct contexts; Super Admin is an authorization caveat, not a context substitute.

records.label: Internal WPE Route
records.notes: Custom items are market parity; WPE exposes registered internal routes only, never arbitrary executable callbacks.

records.label: Validated Admin / External URL
records.notes: Custom URLs are market parity while scheme/host validation remains a WPE safety boundary.

records.label: Separator / Group / Submenu Composition
records.notes: Separators, groups and submenu composition are established market capabilities.

records.label: Named Menu Profile
records.notes: Named portable menu profiles remain a WPE composition layer beyond the reviewed universal market baseline.

records.label: Role / User / Site / Network Assignment
records.notes: Per-role/per-user assignment is market parity; this surface stores bounded references only and does not own grants.

records.label: Preview as Role/User
records.notes: Non-impersonating diagnostic preview remains a WPE differentiation with no account mutation.

records.label: Admin Bar Transform / Custom Item
records.notes: Admin Bar node graph is native; arbitrary executable HTML/onclick is not an authored Bank capability.

records.label: Recovery Route / Missing Target / Conflict Handling
records.notes: Recovery/import-export exists in reviewed products; WPE retains deterministic missing-target and conflict diagnostics.

records.label: Unsafe URL Scheme
records.notes: Market custom-link flexibility does not justify executable or unsafe URL schemes.

coverage.notes: Native and current market evidence now reconcile all 16 records. Transform/custom-item/assignment/recovery families are market-classified, named profiles/preview remain WPE competitive composition, authorization remains Roles/Policy-owned, and unsafe URLs stay rejected.
